limitations: The source does not map the four generic RAW identifiers to chondroitinase and/or heparinase treatments; no treatment or factor value is asserted.
Biological replicate 1 is assigned separately to each RAW-derived source identifier solely as a required coordinate; it does not assert the four injections are biological replicates of one condition.
Cellosaurus describes donor age and sex for the line; these are provenance attributes, not measured properties of the culture-medium samples.

The PRIDE protocol specifies serum-free RPMI but no formulation number or resolvable NCIT term; the annotation uses the template-permitted not available value for culture medium. The processing protocol also specifies three variable GAG-glycopeptide Ser hexasaccharide modifications (993.2809, 1073.2377, 1153.1945 Da); no verified Unimod/PSI-MOD accession is available for those exact structures, so they are recorded in the report rather than assigned a fabricated CV term.
